app.name: Sjodur
app.tagline: Budget book, forecast and investments in one app.
app.footer: Sjodur – from the Icelandic sjóður, “the fund”.

home.title: See where your money goes – and where it is heading.
home.lead: Sjodur brings budget book, cash-flow forecast and investment overview into one picture.

ledger.title: Budget book
ledger.text: Accounts, categories, recurring entries and imports – the view of today.

forecast.title: Forecast
forecast.text: Balances months ahead, play through scenarios, get warned before an account runs dry.

invest.title: Investments
invest.text: Savings plans, ETFs and stocks next to everyday finances – your wealth as a whole.

dashboard.lead: Your budget book will live here. Until then this page shows that login and API work together.
